summary_1line: Victor animates the creature, recoils in horror, falls ill from shock, and is nursed by Henry Clerval until spring.

image_candidates.scene_text: By the dying candlelight, the creature’s dull yellow eye opens as Victor stands over the lifeless body he has just animated.
In moonlight filtering through the shutters, the newly created monster pulls back Victor’s bed curtain and reaches toward him as he recoils in terror.
Victor wanders the rain-soaked courtyard at night, glancing fearfully over his shoulder as if a fiend were following him.
